 The 'Grey's Anatomy' and 'Animal Kingdom' actor adds to an already stacked lineup alongside Billy Bob Thornton and Demi Moore
 By
 David Hookstead Fox News 
 Published
 November 19, 2026 11:31am EST Comments

 close Video 'Landman' star Ali Larter says life in Idaho is 'simpler' after leaving Los Angeles for her family's sake 
 Ali Larter told Fox News Digital that her summers look a lot different 6 years after ditching LA for Idaho.
 The cast of "Landman" is growing.
 The popular series created by Taylor Sheridan focuses on the oil business in Texas, and it's been an entertainment monster through its first two seasons.
 One of the reasons the show is such a draw is that it features a cast with star power rarely seen on TV. That includes Billy Bob Thornton, Ali Larter, Demi Moore , Sam Elliott, Michelle Randolph, Jacob Lofland and Jon Hamm (season one only).
 TAYLOR SHERIDAN'S 'LANDMAN' SEASON 3 IS FILMING AT TCU IN FORT WORTH WITH 30 CHEERLEADERS ON SET 
 Well, now some more recognizable star power is joining for season three.
 Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris and Ali Larter as Angela Norris in Landman episode 1, season 2, streaming on Paramount+. Photo Credit: Emerson Miller/Paramount+ (Emerson Miller/Paramount+) 
 Scott Speedman joins "Landman" season three cast.
 Deadline reported Wednesday that actor Scott Speedman is joining the cast for season three of the series.
 Deadline reported that "details regarding his character are under wraps" for the time being. Production is also already underway on the upcoming third season .
 Actor Scott Speedman at Series Premiere of TNT's New Original Drama, "Animal Kingdom" during Tribeca Film Festival at SVA Theatre 1 on April 17, 2016 in New York City. ((Photo by Paul Zimmerman/Getty Images for TNT)) 
 Speedman has a long and very successful acting career. He's appeared in "R.J. Decker," "Animal Kingdom," "Grey's Anatomy" and many other notable projects.
 My personal favorite is "Last Resort." While the show didn't last long and wasn't particularly great TV, it was incredibly entertaining.
 Now, he's joining one of Taylor Sheridan's most successful series , and will plus up a cast that is already outrageously stacked with talent.

 It goes to show that Sheridan's draw for big names is unrivaled when it comes to TV.
 Scott Speedman attends SAG-AFTRA Foundation Conversations - "Teacup" at SAG-AFTRA Foundation Robin Williams Center on November 07, 2024 in New York City. ((Photo by Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images))
